coordinator_signal_test.scope: SIGINT and SIGTERM, cooperative and stubborn runner; actual collect_results plus merge_results preserves started unknown attempt and remaining unrun slots. Checks runner leader termination/reaping; independent descendant behavior is not claimed.

limitations: Candidate/profile containers created through the runner are covered. Official SWE-bench SDK grader containers are outside this ownership hook.
